title: Work with CSP
content_data:
If Content Security Policy (CSP) is enabled on your website, for TikTok Pixel to work properly, you need to add configurations and domains to various CSP directives. - For `frame-src`, add the configurations below. - `bytedance:` - `sslocal:` > **Note**
> `frame-src` is a Content Security Policy (CSP) directive that controls which sources \ or \ elements can load. Browsers block any frames from domains or schemes not listed. For TikTok Pixel, you must include `bytedance:` and `sslocal:` so its tracking and app/webview frames load correctly; otherwise, the Pixel may fail. - For `script-src`, `img-src` and `connect-src` directives, please add the `analytics.tiktok.com`, `analytics-ipv6.tiktokw.us`, and `ads.tiktok.com` domains. > **Note**
> `analytics-ipv6.tiktokw.us` is a domain associated with TikTok's analytics services, specifically for tracking and analytics that use IPv6 addresses. **Example** ```xcodeblock (code http) Content-Security-Policy: frame-src 'self' bytedance: sslocal: ; script-src 'self' analytics.tiktok.com analytics-ipv6.tiktokw.us ads.tiktok.com; img-src 'self' analytics.tiktok.com analytics-ipv6.tiktokw.us ads.tiktok.com; connect-src 'self' analytics.tiktok.com analytics-ipv6.tiktokw.us ads.tiktok.com; (/code) ```
